## History

Prissy Andrews was a student in Mr. Phillips's classroom in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where she was pursued by the teacher and stayed behind after school for private lessons with him. She later was among the older students who joined Miss Stacy's advanced class to prepare for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. After finishing her studies in the advanced class, Prissy passed the entrance exams to Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

## Relationships

### [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Prissy is a student taught by the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolmaster, Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md). Their bond is centered around the classroom environment, where [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) oversees her and the other local children. She remains under his instruction until his ultimate departure from the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.
